text: Strategic adjustment to registration is a function of firm size: firms that planned a strategic response to Dodd-Frank were smaller than firms that did not.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hedge Fund Manager Registration Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2150377

isBasedOn.name: Hedge Fund Manager Registration Under the Dodd-Frank Act

abstract: Firms that planned a strategic response were smaller than those firms that did not plan a strategic response.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: survey respondents, n=94, comparing the twenty-four advisers planning a strategic response with the sixty-two who did not
